name: Umizuri Wakadaishou Satsuki
source:
Today I came to participate in the fishing tournament. I'm looking forward to catching lots of fish, but it's my utmost desire to reveal the mystery behind the mermaid legend at these waters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
今天我来参加钓鱼比赛。我期待着能钓到很多鱼，但我最大的愿望是在这片水域揭开美人鱼传说背后的秘密。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-november-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
